episodes.title: Andy Ngo EXPOSES the Trans Death Cult Tied to a Seattle Grad
episodes.description:
Eight people are dead, a Border Patrol agent was gunned down in Vermont, and one of the accused shooters graduated from Seattle's elite Lakeside School. So why has almost no one heard of the Zizians? Andy Ngo says the answer is the "kryptonite for the media": nearly every member is trans-identifying.

Ngo joins Jason Rantz to break down his new book, "The Zizians: Inside a Trans Death Cult," and the story is as wild as it sounds. A cult born out of Silicon Valley rationalism and effective altruism, led by Jack LaSota, recruited what Ngo calls "autistic geniuses" from STEM backgrounds and elite universities, convinced them AI would end the world, and taught them that trans women were uniquely gifted to save it. The body count followed. Teresa Youngblut, a Lakeside grad, is charged in the Vermont ambush of a Border Patrol agent. A man she applied for a marriage license with is charged in Solano County, California with murdering an elderly witness. Prosecutors in four states have filed charges, and nearly two years later not one Zizian has gone to trial.

Ngo traveled the country to the cult's hideouts, interviewed terrified witnesses and family members, and documents members "performing human experimentations on one another." He also goes into the academic research on cross-sex hormones and aggression, and explains why the Seattle Times, the New York Times, and even law enforcement keep hiding the ball. When Rantz asks whether a single non-conservative outlet has shown interest in the book, the answer says everything.

Andy Ngo's reporting on the Zizians, the Zizian cult, the Vermont Border Patrol agent shooting, Teresa Youngblut, Jack LaSota, Lakeside School in Seattle, trans violence, AI doomers, rationalism, and the legacy media's silence is the deepest coverage of this story anywhere, and it starts right here on the Jason Rantz Show.
